name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For Rc::<T>::from_raw(ptr) to be safe, the caller must ensure that a specific value of T is dropped at most once.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Rc < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express this requirement: it has no observations for drop events or their count over a value’s lifetime.
